canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the Verdant Shore's chapter of the book of lore, its lines the game's; the Verdant Ocean, the Keepers and the Root-Mother are CANON (book3; world_bible.md), as each line says.

entries.subject: Rootfast
entries.more: The Keepers read their tale-book aloud at dusk to whoever sits: of the Keeper who held a shining seed a hundred years, and found it shone only because she held it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Keepers' bower and their rule against hoarding are CANON (book3 ch.2, 7); the tale is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Veridian Temple
entries.more: Willow-Whisper would not call it a song: the Root-Mother dreams of rain still deciding to fall, of every root on the Shore at once, and of a cold she will not name.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Root-Mother is CANON (book3); the dream as told is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Whispering Glade
entries.more: Sister Iselle listened in the glade for eleven days for the Original Song's three notes: Earth under hearing, Spirit at dusk, and a gap where the third should be.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Original Song's three notes are CANON (book3 ch.5, world_bible.md); Iselle's listening is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Salt-Flats
entries.more: The Salt-Menders' tide-post counts the years the salt came further in, a notch a year, with a name by some. Older than the ships, Ondine says, and that is the point of it.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Salt-Flats (book3 ch.3) and the Salt-Menders are CANON; the post is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Mossveil Falls
entries.more: Willow-Whisper left a leaf at the lip for the ones who will come over the ridge one day. The river remembers every face that ever looked down from here.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL foreshadowing within CANON: the Verdant Ocean and the survivors who crest the ridge are CANON (book3 ch.1-4); the leaf is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Verdant Ocean
entries.more: What the Keepers sing to a sapling on its first night: before the first leaf, the Mother; before the Mother, the sea. Grow slow, little one.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Root-Mother and the First Cycle are CANON (book3 ch.2, 7; world_bible.md); the song is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Fern Hollow
entries.more: A Keeper slept a hundred years under these ferns, and the moss where she lay still glows like a banked coal, warm to the hand.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Greying
entries.more: Willow-Whisper says a cold came before the first leaf, out of nowhere, and went back there, and the Root-Mother remembers it. The Ghost-Oaks here are going grey from the heart out.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Root-Mother and the cold that unmade the cycle before this one are CANON (book3 ch.6-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Ondine Varro
entries.more: She came with the glass-ships to chart the shore, and has read what the last one left: a log kept dry under a drift-log above the tide-line, out of Port Caelum.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: Port Caelum and its glass ships are CANON (world_bible.md); Ondine and the log are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Moss-Lantern
entries.more: She cut the count of the lanterns into bark, from the First Cycle on, and left it on the rock above the glade for any flesh-folk who climb that high.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Sister Iselle
entries.more: Brother Wystan went below the root-stair to find the missing note and did not come back. Iselle has his silver mask, and the page that was folded in its lining.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Silent Pilgrims and their silver masks are CANON (book3 ch.5); Wystan is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Willow-Whisper
entries.more: Every Keeper who goes down to sit with the Root-Mother cuts one mark by the sap pool. There are more marks than there are Keepers. She has stopped counting them.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Reed-Song
entries.more: Lichen-Still stayed with the Root-Mother when the cold first came into the root, and the root took the stone in like a hand closing. Reed-Song carries the lamps down.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL foreshadowing within CANON: the Root-Mother and the cold in the root (book3 ch.6-7); Lichen-Still is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Oak-Bane
entries.more: The ore-hunter asked first, so Oak-Bane let him through the briar way. Oak-Bane went down after, to bring him up, and left him where the root had taken him.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Alder-Knot
entries.more: Alder-Knot carved the moss-saint in the little shrine east of the glowing caps, and will not say whose face it has.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Moss-backed boar
entries.line: Boar with moss growing on their backs, so slow in the green that they pass for hummocks until they move.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Old Brine-Tusk
entries.line: A great boar of the salt shore, his tusks white with salt-crust. He eats what the tide leaves.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Moss-antler stag
entries.line: Stags whose antlers grow moss as the trees do. The Keepers do not hunt them, and ask you not to, and know you will.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Basalt spider
entries.line: Black spiders of the ridge's basalt, the colour of the rock until they move.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Canopy spider
entries.line: Spiders that live in the high leaves and come down on a thread, quieter than a leaf falling.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Creeping briar
entries.line: Briars that walk, slowly, toward anything warm. The Keepers cut them back from the bower every spring.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Withered Keeper
entries.line: Keepers gone grey from the heart out, like the Ghost-Oaks they slept under. They walk their old rounds and do not know you.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Greyheart
entries.line: The oldest of the withered, at the heart of the grey stand. He was a Voice of the Wood, once.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Mist-walker
entries.line: Shapes in the hollow's fog that walk when you walk and stop when you stop.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY

entries.subject: Void-Toucher
entries.line: Mist-walkers that touched the void below the ridge and came back wrong. The air goes still round them.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL foreshadowing: the void eating at the world is CANON (world_bible.md); these are GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Pale shadow
entries.line: A shadow among the trees where nothing casts it, cold and counting.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL foreshadowing within CANON: the Pale Things as cosmic auditors are CANON (world_bible.md); this one is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: Old Ninebranch
entries.line: The old king of the stags, nine tines to a side. The Keepers say he remembers the First Cycle.
entries.canonStatus: CANON-EXPANDED: the Veridian Keepers are CANON (book3 ch.1-7); this telling is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: The Hollow Root-Warden
entries.line: The guardian of the deep root, gone hollow in the cold that came up it. It still guards; it no longer remembers what.
entries.canonStatus: PROVISIONAL foreshadowing within CANON: the Root-Mother and the cold in the root (book3 ch.6-7); the Warden is GAME-ONLY.

entries.subject: node.veridian
entries.line: Veridian, the green-bronze ore of the Shore's deep ground. The Keepers say it is the Mother's and not for selling, and look the other way.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: node.veridian_rich
entries.line: Where the green runs thick, under the temple and in the deep halls, the seams come away in slabs.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: node.ghostoak
entries.line: Ghost-Oak windfalls: pale wood, light as cork and harder than iron. A Ghost-Oak takes a hundred years to fall and a hundred more to rot.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: node.dewfern
entries.line: Dewfern holds the morning's dew all day in its curled fronds. The Keepers drink from it and leave the plant.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.

entries.subject: herb.lantern_moss
entries.line: Moss that glows like a banked coal, gold-green and warm. The Keepers say it grows where one of them once slept a hundred years.
entries.canonStatus: GAME-ONLY: the trades' herbs and metals.
